title: Nuluno Access Community 0.1.0-alpha.1 preview
notes:
Apache-2.0 Nuluno Access Community 0.1.0-alpha.1 prerelease.

This release is bound to source commit f833a4b8ab095055d45a72056d73a0e4d73a919a and the reviewed readiness run 43595149251. It contains scoped keys, encrypted vault, persistent tasks, reconciliation/revocation, REST/MCP/SDK and the existing-account Mastodon adapter. Commercial Gmail verification/signup and Threads implementations are not included.

An actual isolated Codex public-read trial obtained bounded untrusted post text and reused the original task; owner readback recorded one native GET and zero writes. The revoked key was denied. Process-restart demos and the controlled localhost lost-write demonstration retain their separate evidence classes. Private Gmail-to-signup/publication acceptance, sales lift and lower complete costs remain unverified. Official consent, identity checks and CAPTCHA are not bypassed.

This is not an npm/PyPI publication, a permanent hosted service, or a signed-attestation claim. Four fixed public assets only: npm-format archive, source ZIP, release manifest and SHA256SUMS. The manifest describes readiness before publication.
